# G05a-usage-cached-tokens: G05 decides cached-token subtraction (synthesized, pending live confirmation), on Gemini 0.64 (the first to answer session/prompt with usage): inputTokens is the prompts' promptTokenCount, which counts the cached reads too, so input = inputTokens - cachedReadTokens; thoughtTokens are reasoning; totalTokens is inputTokens + outputTokens (it cannot tell). A usage_update follows each model call (used = that call's input + output); neither it nor _meta.quota is added on top.
# Needs Gemini 0.64 or later (0.62 and 0.63 send no usage). Confirms G05 when usage.inputTokens equals _meta.quota.token_count.input_tokens (promptTokenCount, which includes the cached content) with cachedReadTokens > 0; Gemini's totalTokens (input + output) cannot tell.
